title: Iki action (iki/v1)
description: Something a plugin does to entities: compute properties, create new entities from them, or import them. Each run records what it read, what it wrote and where it ran.

name.description: The action's name in snake_case. Elsewhere it is `plugin.name`.

inputs.description: The entities a run reads, by name. Leave it out for an action that imports or fetches entities.

params.description: The values a person (or an agent) chooses when they run it, by name.

effects.description: What a run may write. Its output is checked against these, and anything else is refused.

runs_on.description: Where it runs: a compute tier and one of the plugin's environments.

lifecycle.description: For the container and vm tiers: a machine for each run (`ephemeral`, the default), or a warm pool (`persistent`).

resources.description: More than the environment's minimum, if this action needs it.

command.description: What the worker runs, as a list of arguments (no shell). Paths are relative to the plugin's root, or absolute inside its image.

deterministic.description: The same inputs and params always give the same results, so an earlier run's results can be reused.

checkpointable.description: It saves its progress in $IKI_CHECKPOINT_DIR, so an interrupted run resumes instead of starting again.

batchable.description: How many entities one job may handle at once, for quick actions with one input.

artifacts.description: Files a run writes besides its results, kept for people to download.

keep.description: Glob patterns, relative to the run's output directory.

network.description: The hosts a run may reach. None by default: runs have no network access. `{settings.<name>}` is the host a deployment gives in that setting, which has `format: hostname`.

metrics.description: The numbers its runs report about themselves (`metrics` in their output), by name, such as a score. A workflow's conditions can read those declared here.

secrets.description: Secrets a run needs, by name, such as `NCBI_API_KEY`. Each deployment keeps them in its secret manager, for this plugin alone; runs get them as environment variables, and their logs never show them.

required.description: Whether the action can run without it. Defaults to true.

description.description: For the administrators who set it: what it's for, and where to get one.

timeout.description: The longest a run may take before it's stopped. Defaults to 1h; at most 7d.

on.description: Which failures are retried. A run that ended in an error of its own isn't, unless `failed` is listed.

tier.description: `client`: the person's own machine. `backend`: Iki's isolated worker pods. `container`: the plugin's image on Kubernetes. `vm`: a virtual machine, with GPUs if needed.

duration.description: A length of time, such as `90s`, `30m`, `8h` or `365d`.

constraint.description: The schema versions it works with, such as `>=2` or `>=2,<4`.

type.description: The type of entity it takes; its subtypes are taken too.

max.description: With `many`: the most entities one run takes.

type.description: `file`: a file the person uploads or chooses, such as one to import. The command finds it in input.json's `files`, by the ID in `params`.

required.description: The person must choose a value. A param with a default can't be required.

default.description: The value when the person doesn't choose one.

type.description: The type of entity it creates.

match_on.description: One of the type's unique fields, such as a LIMS record's ID. A create whose value an entity in the run's project has already updates that entity instead, as a revision with its origin.

derived_from.description: The inputs each created entity comes from, for its lineage.

input.description: The input whose entities it changes.

fields.description: The fields it sets on them.
